Name: (CP) Vincent and Jas. Rizz and Dumb Prodigy
Author: Syreliane
Description:
This mod replaces all (I hope I got it all) of Vincent’s and Jas’s base game dialogue with fully reimagined versions. Vincent’s lines are now entirely rizzed-up, translated into the chaotic, hilarious, and utterly infectious “Skibidi Sigma Child” language. Jas, on the other hand, alternates between adorably dumby speech and surprisingly prodigious phrasing, with most lines having a 50/50 chance to pick either, making her dialogue both endearing and unexpectedly clever.

All daily dialogues, heart events, random interactions, and special scenes are preserved and updated, including moments where both characters appear together. There are no new portraits or artwork. Vincent still looks like Vincent, and Jas still looks like Jas, but their personalities explode through every line. Vincent now talks like he finally discovered Wi-Fi and hasn’t logged off since, while Jas delivers a charming mix of goofy innocence and bursts of surprising intelligence.

The optional Events file combines both Vincent and Jas in shared scenes, giving you interactions that fully reflect Vincent’s rizz and Jas’s dumby-prodigy duality. This ensures that overlapping events play perfectly without conflicts, while keeping the main files clean and separate.

Downloads.Description: This optional file updates shared event scenes between Vincent and Jas, combining Vincent’s rizz and Jas’s dumby-prodigy dialogue into seamless interactions. Should be used with both main files for full effect.
